lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×10

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Thanks for visiting!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Here's a little reward for

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: bringing me those DVDs and Nutrium.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I know I haven't been here for long,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but it's still nice to have someone over.
We had fun visiting as well.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Feel free to drop by whenever you have the time.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: After all,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: my schedule is wide open.
So you're not intending to return?

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I doubt it.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: If I head back, my debt is the only thing that'll be waiting for me.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'd probably be charged for fleeing to the surface illegally,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: so I'd either be fined or sent to prison.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: In any case, that wouldn't exactly be a warm welcome.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: So there's no turning back now

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: and I don't want to turn back, either.
If you ever change your mind, just let me know.
Whatever path you choose, I'll be rooting for you all the way.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I appreciate it,

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: but I don't think I'll be returning.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Haha, thank you!

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: That's very kind of you.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Hee-hee

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: I'm glad I was able to

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: meet someone like you, Commander.

lines.speaker: refugee
lines.text: Please take care, and stay safe!
